s.n: Blue corn chips with red chile salsa
s.how: Toast 4 dried red chillies in a dry pan, soak in hot water 15 minutes and drain. Blitz with 3 tomatoes, 2 garlic cloves, the juice of 1 lime and salt until smooth. Serve with 230g blue corn chips.

s.note: lunch at the Los Alamos lab
s.how: Boil 6 eggs for 10 minutes, cool, peel and chop. Mix with 4 tbsp mayonnaise, 1 tsp Dijon and 1 finely diced celery stick, season well. Fill 8 slices white bread and cut into triangles.

m.note: a New Mexico pot on the stove
m.how: Brown 1kg diced pork shoulder, then soften 1 onion and 3 garlic cloves. Char 6 large green chillies, peel, chop and add with 600g diced potatoes and 1L chicken stock. Simmer 90 minutes until the pork is tender. Serve with 8 warm flour tortillas.

w.how: Mix 250g flour, 2 tsp baking powder, 1/2 tsp salt and 20g butter, then add 160ml warm water to a soft dough. Rest 20 minutes, roll 5mm thick and cut into 12 squares. Fry at 185C for 1 minute a side until puffed. Tear open and fill with honey.

d.note: the martinis he was known for
d.how: Touch the rim of 4 chilled glasses with a little honey and lime. For each drink, stir 60ml gin with a splash of dry vermouth over ice and strain in. Serve iced lime soda the same way for anyone off the gin.
